url.ask: OPC UA endpoint of the Biobrain (or DCU OPC UA) server
url.help: Biobrain serves OPC UA on port 4840 of the controller's IP (Sartorius application note on Biobrain Supervise, Aug 2023). UaExpert must connect with Sign and Encrypt / Basic256Sha256 before this package will.

user.ask: Biobrain device user the agent connects as
user.help: A Biobrain user with the Remote operation permission (Administrators have it by default). Make a dedicated one rather than sharing the administrator account.

unit.ask: Unit (vessel) name as Biobrain shows it
unit.help: Each vessel on a twin or multi-unit tower is a unit; its node ids start with this name.

nodes.ask: Node ids per signal, setpoint and recipe method (from the site's OPC UA interface report)
nodes.help: Keep the keys of config.example.json and replace every id with the one UaExpert shows for your unit. The shipped ids are placeholders.

poll_s.ask: Seconds between phase polls during a batch

max_batch_hours.ask: Longest a recipe may run before the job is failed

max_feed_hours.ask: Longest a single add_feed may take
